description: The chart is a 3D bar chart illustrating model accuracy across different reasoning task types, with two model categories shown. The categorical axis is arranged along the base of the 3D plot: one dimension lists the task types “Inductive,” “Abductive,” “Deductive,” and “Mix” (shown as discrete categories), and the other dimension lists the models “Davinci-003” and “BARD.” The value axis is the vertical axis labeled “Accuracy,” shown on a linear scale from 0 to about 0.8 with tick marks at regular 0.2 intervals (0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.6, 0.8). Each model–task combination is represented by a single vertical bar with a blue-to-yellow gradient fill (blue near the base transitioning to green/yellow near the top) and black edges; for Davinci-003, the bars are approximately 0.30 (Inductive), 0.45 (Abductive), 0.75 (Deductive), and 0.70 (Mix), and for BARD, the bars are approximately 0.15 (Inductive), 0.35 (Abductive), 0.40 (Deductive), and 0.65 (Mix). The bars are displayed as a grid of individual (non-stacked) bars corresponding to the two models across the four task categories, with no legend and no visible annotations or special emphasis beyond the consistent gradient coloring and 3D perspective; the categories appear in the labeled order shown rather than being sorted by bar height.
